title: 第二百八十一章 朱华音的决心第二百八十章 生死与共
slug: 斗罗之张三的逆袭人生
content_zh:
“张三！你听着！”
朱华音猛地拔出腰间短剑，横在自己颈前，眼神决绝：“如果你不走，我现在就自刎于此！至少能让你没有拖累！”
“你敢！”张三转身怒视她，眼中燃烧着从未有过的怒火，“朱华音！你为什么要把自己看得那么轻？！你的生命，和我张三的生命一样重要！我相信比比东她同样也需要你，需要你的忠诚，需要你的能力！你怎么能就这样放弃？！”
张三一步踏前，几乎要与朱华音额头相抵，声音斩钉截铁：“我告诉你，如果你今天敢死在这里——我张三随后就到！黄泉路上，你我作伴！”
“你……你简直不可理喻！”朱华音被他这番话说得又气又急，手中的短剑微微颤抖，竟真的不知该不该落下。她看着张三眼中那毫不作伪的决意，心中某处柔软的地方被狠狠触动，最终只能哭笑不得地放下短剑，“行吧，要死就死一块，我管不了你……”
张三见她放下短剑，心中稍安，但脸上依旧严肃。他重新转过身，面向那已然逼近的血瞳鬼蛛王和它身后密密麻麻的精英蜘蛛大军。
残月悬空，荒冢寂寂。
两人摆开架势直面万千蛛潮，与八万年兽王。
而在他身后，朱华音握着白银玄凤笛的手指，微微收紧。
她看着张三那并不宽阔、却异常坚定的背影，眼中闪过一丝复杂难明的光芒。
张三……
你可真是个傻瓜……
残月如钩，映照着墓园中密密麻麻的幽绿复眼。
血瞳鬼蛛王那八只燃烧着血红火焰的眼睛死死盯着场中两人，周围的精英蜘蛛们蓄势待发，随时准备发动致命一击。
“张三，你……”
朱华音看着挡在自己身前的背影，胸中涌起一种难以言喻的复杂情绪。她从未想过，有朝一日会有人如此坚决地挡在她面前，甚至不惜与她同生共死。
所谓患难见真情，张三为人坦荡，这番生死绝境也不愿抛弃，足见其可靠。
看着对方坚毅的身影，朱华音竟也有些面颊微红。
张三回头看了她一眼，嘴角勉强扯出一个笑容:“朱前辈，我……”
话音未落——

“嘶——！！！”
血瞳鬼蛛王率先发动攻击！
显然其对两人把自己当空气的行为非常恼怒，它那庞大身躯下八条擎天巨柱般的长腿如同八柄长矛猛地刺向地面，随后就冒出八道血色魂力激流从地面射出攻击两人所在的位置！
与此同时，周围的精英蜘蛛群也如同黑色的潮水，从四面八方汹涌而来！
“小心！”朱华音一把推开张三，白银玄凤笛横在唇边，身后第三魂环亮起——
“第三魂技·孤山鸣！”
无形的声波在她身前凝聚成一面土黄色护盾的屏障，勉强挡住了血瞳鬼蛛王的冲击。然而那巨大的力量仍震得她七窍流血。
“朱前辈！”张三眼中闪过焦急之色，他清楚以朱华音的状态，根本支撑不了多久。
“别管我！你快……”
朱华音话说到一半，就见数只鬼面毒蛛，从侧面扑来！
不过朱华音的孤山鸣能让周围环境重力改变，这些敏捷的猎手现在行动迟缓无比。
张三见状眼神一凛，双爪化作两道黑色残影，与那几只鬼面蛛缠斗在一起。他的攻击精准而致命，每一击都直指蜘蛛的复眼和关节薄弱处，短短几息间便有三只鬼面蛛毙命。
但更多的蜘蛛涌了上来。
content_en:
"Zhang San! Listen!"
Zhu Huayin suddenly pulled out the dagger from his waist and placed it in front of his neck, with a determined look in his eyes: "If you don't leave, I will kill myself here now! At least I won't be a drag on you!"
"How dare you!" Zhang San turned around and glared at her, eyes burning with unprecedented anger, "Zhu Huayin! Why do you take yourself so lightly?! Your life is as important as my life, Zhang San! I believe Bibi Dong also needs you, your loyalty, and your ability! How can you give up like this?!"
Zhang San stepped forward, almost touching Zhu Huayin's forehead, and said with a firm voice: "I tell you, if you dare to die here today - I, Zhang San, will be there soon! You and I will be my companions on the road to hell!"
"You...you are simply unreasonable!" Zhu Huayin was so angry and anxious at his words that the dagger in his hand trembled slightly, and he really didn't know whether he should drop it or not. She looked at the unfaltering determination in Zhang San's eyes, and a soft spot in her heart was severely touched. In the end, she could only put down the dagger in a state of laughter and tears, "Okay, if you want to die, die together, I can't control you..."
Seeing her put down her dagger, Zhang San felt a little relieved, but his face was still serious. He turned around again and faced the approaching Blood-Eyed Ghost Spider King and the dense army of elite spiders behind it.
The waning moon hangs in the sky, and the deserted graves are silent.
The two of them took up positions and faced thousands of spiders and the 80,000-year-old beast king.
Behind him, Zhu Huayin's fingers holding the Silver Black Phoenix Flute tightened slightly.
She looked at Zhang San's back that was not broad but extremely firm, and a complicated and unexplainable light flashed in her eyes.
Zhang San...
You are such a fool...
The waning moon is like a hook, reflecting the dense green compound eyes in the cemetery.
The eight eyes of the Blood-Eyed Ghost Spider King, burning with blood-red flames, stared at the two people in the field. The elite spiders around them were ready to launch a fatal blow at any time.
"Zhang San, you..."
Zhu Huayin looked at the figure standing in front of him, feeling an indescribable complex emotion well up in his chest. She never thought that one day someone would be so determined to stand in front of her, even willing to live and die with her.
As the saying goes, a friend in need is a friend indeed. Zhang San is a magnanimous person, and he is unwilling to give up even in this desperate situation, which shows his reliability.
Looking at the other party's resolute figure, Zhu Huayin's cheeks turned slightly red.
Zhang San looked back at her and forced a smile: "Senior Zhu, I..."
Before he finished speaking——
"Hiss-!!!"
The Blood-Eyed Ghost Spider King takes the lead in attacking!
Obviously it was very angry at the two people treating themselves like nothing. The eight long legs like Optimus Pillars under its huge body stabbed towards the ground like eight spears, and then eight bloody torrents of soul power shot out from the ground to attack the location of the two!
At the same time, the surrounding elite spider groups were like a black tide, surging in from all directions!
"Be careful!" Zhu Huayin pushed Zhang San away, holding the silver black phoenix flute to his lips, and the third soul ring behind him lit up——
"The third soul skill·Gushan Ming!"
The invisible sound waves condensed into an earth-yellow shield in front of her, barely blocking the impact of the Blood-Eyed Ghost Spider King. However, the huge force still caused her to bleed.
"Senior Zhu!" An anxious look flashed in Zhang San's eyes. He knew that Zhu Huayin could not last long in his condition.
"Leave me alone! Hurry up..."
Halfway through Zhu Huayin's words, he saw several ghost-faced poisonous spiders rushing towards him from the side!
However, Zhu Huayin's Gushan Ming can change the gravity of the surrounding environment, and these agile hunters are now extremely slow.
Zhang San's eyes froze when he saw this, and his claws turned into two black afterimages, fighting with the ghost-faced spiders. His attacks were precise and deadly. Each blow was directed at the spider's compound eyes and weak joints. In just a few breaths, three ghost-faced spiders were killed.
But more spiders came up.
